metrics.scope: NumPy64 scored native160. CFA/ROI repetitions average within source before equal-source means. Local band pools CFA/ROI blocks within source; repeated/overlapping blocks add no independent sources. Reference noise may contribute to fine bands; these measure reference recovery, not exact scene-detail recovery.

native_review.actual_viewing: All12 boards/480 unchanged native cells actually viewed across20 regions and three noise priors. Four new public triplets share exact corresponding board pixels.
native_review.findings: All joint versions retain substantially finer grass/wood/brick/branch/letter detail than released RawNIND. High-noise grass/foliage remain soft. Differences among V117/V119/V120/V121 are subtle; no clear large V121 detail improvement.
native_review.limits: Binned low-noise reference estimates retain reduced sensor noise and optics. This tests fixed reference recovery under added noise, not real highISO or broad camera superiority. Reference-band gains can include residual reference noise; the weakest bin has only4 contributing captures.
